title: Avionics FPGA Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Purpose of

ROLE:
The role involves contributing to the entire FPGA based product development flow starting from requirement analysis till final product testing in lab environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
· The candidate will be responsible for architecture/micro-architecture design and implementation of the logic in Verilog/VHDL for targeted FPGA, writing test benches to validate the design etc. · Job involves frequent interaction with board design, software, testing and lab teams to deliver the product meeting the customer requirements. · Job involves understanding and working with interfaces such as Ethernet, USB, SD ,I2C, SPI/QSPI etc. · Contributing to/participating in internal design reviews to ensure adherence to the company FPGA design process. Technical Skills: · BE/ME in Electronics from a reputed college. Specialization in VLSI and Embedded Design is a plus. · 3 to 7 years of experience in designing and implementing FPGA based solution in Xilinx or Altera FPGA, preferably FPGA based product development experience. · Must have experience in System Design with Xilinx/Altera FPGA devices with relevant tools. · Must have experience in Verilog and/or VHDL coding. · Must have experience in synthesis and implementation (floor planning and placement and routing) using FPGA tools. · Must have experience in using constraints to achieve timing requirement. · Experience in working on high speed FPGA designs is a major plus. · Thorough knowledge of Static Timing Analysis (STA) is an added advantage. · Must have experience in building test bench for verification. · Must have experience in board level testing and system debugging. · Must have knowledge in any of the protocols like UFS, Uni Pro, USB, Ethernet, PCIe, I3C, I2C, SPI, QSPI, UART, JTAG, SPMI, RFFE, SD, e MMC etc. · Must have hands on experience with FPGA debugging tools and test & measurement instruments such as oscilloscope and Logic Analyzer. · Should have strong problem solving and debugging skills. Other Skills: · Strong communication and interpersonal skills. · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. · Excellent Project Management skills. · Excellent Time Management skills. · Team building skills. Qualification Essential: · Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering (ECE/EEE/EIE). ROLE:
We are seeking dedicated Avionics Quality and Test Engineers to drive and uphold the quality of our avionics design and development processes, ensuring the delivery of zero-defect systems within the required timelines. This role is categorized as job level 1 and is ideal for candidates with 2-4 years of experience, depending on their educational background. We strongly encourage applicants with a background in electronics design or testing who are enthusiastic about transitioning into a Quality Engineer role. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail, a deep interest in improving product quality and reliability, and the ability to independently analyze designs, identify potential failure modes, and implement corrective actions to optimize design.

title: Lead - Methods Engineer (Composites)
jobDescription:
Job Description About Skyroot Aerospace A cutting-edge startup founded by ex-ISRO scientists. Dedicated to affordable space access, we're rewriting aerospace technology rules. Our dynamic team fosters inventiveness, collaboration, and relentless excellence. Join us on a transformative journey to redefine space possibilities. Welcome to the forefront of space innovation with Skyroot Aerospace! Purpose of

ROLE:
A Composites Methods Engineer specializes in the design, development, and manufacturing processes of composite materials They ensure that composite materials (like carbon fiber, fiberglass, and resins) are effectively integrated into product designs and manufactured efficiently. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the roles and responsibilities of a Composites Methods Engineer. Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Design and Development • Develop methods for the design and manufacturing of composite materials for components and structures. • Work with design teams to ensure composite materials meet the necessary structural, thermal, and durability requirements. • Evaluate and analyze product designs for manufacturability and suggest design changes to optimize the use of composite materials. • Generate CAD models, technical drawings, and tooling designs for composite components. • Provide recommendations to improve product designs, focusing on manufacturability and material performance.
2. Material Selection and Testing • Research and select appropriate composite materials (carbon fiber, Kevlar, glass fiber, resins) for different applications. • Perform material testing, including tensile, compression, and fatigue testing, to verify that selected materials meet the required standards and specifications. • Develop test methods for evaluating the performance of composite structures under various conditions. • Analyze and interpret test data to refine material choices and process parameters.
3. Manufacturing Process Development and Optimization • Develop and improve composite manufacturing processes (e.g., layup, curing, resin infusion, and autoclaving). • Optimize production methods to ensure efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and high quality. • Create work instructions and technical documentation to guide manufacturing teams in the production of composite materials. • Work closely with production teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to composite manufacturing.
4. Tooling and Equipment Management • Design and develop tooling, jigs, and fixtures required for the manufacture of composite components. • Coordinate the procurement and maintenance of specialized equipment for composite manufacturing (e.g., autoclaves, vacuum systems, CNC machines). • Evaluate tooling designs and make recommendations for improvement based on production feedback.
5. Quality Control and Assurance • Develop and implement quality control processes to ensure that composite materials and components meet industry standards (e.g., AS9100 for aerospace). • Inspect and validate composite parts and structures during and after manufacturing. • Collaborate with quality assurance teams to create inspection protocols and ensure compliance with safety and performance standards. • Conduct failure analysis on defective parts and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
6.
